decisions.reason: The wallet requirement for receiving rewards does not alter primary-sale allocation amounts or recipients; separate message-146 revenue changes are already represented.
The candidate already states that no preexisting wallet is required for fiat minting, and the source preserves that rule while addressing post-mint reward access.
Wallet requirements for commissions and prize tickets do not change the $15 primary mint price or its no-hidden-fees condition.
The source decision does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model.
The existing message-146 FAQ MODIFY already captures the revised wallet-requirement copy, so no addition or correction is needed.
A wallet prerequisite for holding rewards or trading does not change which book, referral code, badges, or ticket state transfers with the NFT.
The candidate already records that commission payment requires a recipient wallet; the source does not change the coded-referral commission mechanism.
The wallet-access clarification does not change Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, reset, funding, draw, or winner-selection rules.
The source does not change the random existing-holder allocation used when a mint has no referral code.
The requirement to hold prize tickets in a wallet does not alter the Winners-page announcement, one-click claim method, or claim URL.
Wallet requirements for rewards do not change the mint-number referral-code identity, permanence, or display locations.
The wallet-access rule does not change secondary royalty enforcement, allocation, prize-pool funding, or ticket-generation behavior.
